title: PAIR-SAFE: A Paired-Agent Approach for Runtime Auditing and Refining AI-Mediated Mental Health Support
abstract: arXiv:2601.12754v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLMs are increasingly used for mental health support, yet they can produce responses that are overly directive, inconsistent, or clinically misaligned. Most risk mitigation approaches rely on implicit alignment through training or prompting, offering limited runtime accountability. We introduce PAIR-SAFE, a paired-agent framework that integrates a Responder agent with a Judge agent grounded in the clinically validated Motivational Interviewing Treatment Integrity (MITI-4). The Judge audits each response and issues \allow{} or \revise{} decisions to guide real-time refinement. We evaluate interactions using a support-seeker simulator derived from human-annotated data. The Judge-supervised interactions show significant improvements in key MITI dimensions, including Partnership, Seek Collaboration, and overall Relational quality. translated_title: PAIR-SAFE：一种用于运行时审计与优化AI介导心理健康支持的双智能体方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于心理健康支持，但它们可能产生过于指令化、不一致或与临床实践不符的回复。大多数风险缓解方法依赖于通过训练或提示工程实现的隐式对齐，其运行时问责能力有限。我们提出了PAIR-SAFE，这是一个双智能体框架，将响应者智能体与基于临床验证的动机性访谈治疗完整性标准（MITI-4）构建的评判者智能体相结合。评判者对每个回复进行审计，并发出“允许”或“修改”的决定，以指导实时优化。我们使用从人工标注数据中构建的求助者模拟器来评估交互过程。评判者监督下的交互在关键MITI维度上显示出显著改进，包括伙伴关系、寻求协作以及整体关系质量。我们的定量研究结果得到了专家评估的印证，凸显了运行时监督的细微之处。
tldr: 提出PAIR-SAFE双智能体框架，由基于临床验证MITI-4标准的评判者智能体实时审计并指导修正LLM生成的心理健康支持回复，显著提升了伙伴关系、协作性和整体关系质量。
en_tdlr: PAIR-SAFE introduces a paired-agent framework in which a Judge agent grounded in the clinically validated MITI-4 standard audits and refines LLM-generated mental health support responses in real time, significantly improving key dimensions such as partnership, collaboration, and overall relational quality.
